description: Header file defining Vulkan driver structures, enums, and function prototypes for Vulkan driver generation, including ProcHook, driver tables, and extension management.

classes.name: ProcHook
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan procedure hook with associated type, extension, and function pointers.

classes.name: InstanceDriverTable
classes.description: Contains function pointers for Vulkan instance-level functions.

classes.name: DeviceDriverTable
classes.description: Contains function pointers for Vulkan device-level functions.

methods.name: GetProcHook
methods.description: Retrieves a ProcHook structure by function name.

methods.name: GetProcHookExtension
methods.description: Determines the extension associated with a given procedure hook name.

methods.name: InitDriverTable
methods.description: Initializes Vulkan driver function tables for instance or device.

methods.name: GetInstanceExtensionPromotedVersion
methods.description: Returns the promoted version of a given instance extension.

methods.name: CountPromotedInstanceExtensions
methods.description: Counts the number of promoted instance extensions within a version range.

methods.name: GetPromotedInstanceExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of promoted instance extensions within a version range.
